fact: On 24 July 2026 the National Department of Health issued bid NDOH 09/2026-27 for three years of hosting, maintenance, support and enhancement of the District Health Information System, stating that nine provincial DHIS2 instances capture routine service delivery data while the national instance captures nothing directly, and requiring DHIS2 training for about 6,000 officials at clinic, community health centre, district, regional and tertiary or central hospital, district, provincial and national levels.
title: NDOH 09/2025-2026 Appointment of a service provider for hosting, maintenance, support and enhancement of existing District Health Information System for the National Department of Health for a period of three (3) years
